lifetime: After successful acquire, caller may use address..address+remaining while preserving permission and holding the exact lease. Core leases protect entire record from free/resize; read leases block all record writes, write leases are exclusive.
Core records logical requested bytes, not committed-page padding. No NUL scan, payload access, Win32 file API, Java Context, Java IDs or Java state writes occur in this helper.

Acquire immediately records any real returned token before metadata lookup. Query failure unlocks, calls actual op9, and reports failure. Successful rollback clears token; failed rollback retains token+generation, remaining0, with cleanup error status for explicit retry.
Acquire on an existing nonzero token returns busy2 and preserves the prior lease/bounds. No active token is overwritten.
Any error with token!=0 means caller MUST retry release and retain native resources. Error must never be treated as a usable new span.
Release failure retains token/generation/remaining and records actual status/OS error. Core owner.close remains busy while a real live lease is retained.
Owner/Span control metadata is trusted native caller storage, matching original Core ABI. Unknown payload addresses are never accessed; real Core domain/range validation runs first.
Only readonly/readwrite owned-native permissions; JIMAGE and ThreadIdentifiers domains remain outside the RW owner. No atomic/volatile/CAS or complete stale-raw-address ABA protection is added.
